result.summary: The main visual defect is horizontal content overflow in the restaurant carousel, which cuts off the rightmost card and disrupts the page edge. A second restaurant promotion card is also visibly truncated by the bottom navigation area.

issues.description: The "Fastest near you" horizontal restaurant list overflows the viewport: the third card is cut off at the right edge, with its image, title ("Trattoria Picco..."), and delivery text clipped rather than contained within a clearly managed carousel viewport.
issues.suggestion: Constrain the carousel to the viewport with intentional horizontal scrolling and edge padding, or resize cards/gaps so the visible layout does not expose abruptly clipped content.

issues.description: The next "Popular right now" restaurant card is obscured at the bottom by the fixed navigation bar, leaving only its upper image area visible and hiding its associated details.
issues.suggestion: Add sufficient bottom content padding or account for the fixed tab bar height so the final cards can scroll fully above the navigation.

issues.description: The category chip row is also partially cut off on the right, showing only part of an additional chip without a clear scroll affordance.
issues.suggestion: Use a deliberate horizontally scrollable chip list with a visible affordance/fade, or ensure all chips fit within the available width.
